```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "report.R"))
Standard.target <- c("GISTM", "CDA", "ANCOLD")
```

## Design Spectra {#sec-criteria_results}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.operation.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("tbl.DEQ.operation"), ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    anchor = "sec-criteria-obe-site",
    context = "tailings operational criteria table"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/DEQ.operation.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-figure",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(
      CAP = paste0("Operation. ", readCaption("fig.DEQ.operation")),
      ID.target = ID.gmdp
    ),
    root = root,
    context = "tailings operational criteria figure"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.PGA.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-pga",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(
      CAP = readCaption("tbl.DEQ.PGA"),
      ID.target = ID.gmdp,
      Standard.target = "GISTM",
      Stage.target = "Operation"
    ),
    root = root,
    context = "GISTM design PGA by site condition table"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
